| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `` theme `` | `` dark `` | The colour theme: themes/NAME in the config directory, or a built-in theme, dark or light |
| `` font `` | (empty) | A TrueType or OpenType font file for the grid, or empty for the built-in JetBrains Mono |
| `` fontsize `` | `` 12 `` | The font's size in points, before the display's scaling. Range: 4 to 72 |
| `` backups `` | `` 5 `` | How many earlier versions of each song file saving keeps, in the state directory (, f b lists them); 0 keeps none. Range: 0 to 100 |
| `` recentsongs `` | `` 12 `` | How many song files opened or saved the recent list (, f r) keeps; 0 keeps none. Range: 0 to 100 |
| `` songfolder `` | (empty) | The folder songs are usually kept in, where the file picker starts for a new song and which Places offers as Songs; empty for the home folder |
| `` minsize `` | `` 120x30 `` | The smallest the window can be made, in cells. Range: 20 to 1000 |
| `` timeoutlen `` | `` 500 `` | How long to wait, in milliseconds, after keys that are a binding and also start a longer one, before running the shorter. Range: 0 to 10000 |
| `` leader `` | `` , `` | The leader key, which \<leader\> stands for in key bindings: one key, such as , or \<Space\> |
| `` hints `` | `` on `` | Whether the hint menu shows, after a pause, the keys that can follow those typed |
| `` palettelines `` | `` 10 `` | How many matches the command palette (Ctrl-p) shows below what's typed. Range: 3 to 40 |
| `` hintdelay `` | `` 400 `` | How long to wait, in milliseconds, after keys that start longer bindings, before the hint menu shows what can follow. Range: 0 to 10000 |
| `` timingunit `` | `` grid `` | The note inspector's coarse timing unit: grid, or a note fraction such as 1/16 |
| `` chordwindow `` | `` 30 `` | How far apart, in milliseconds, events can start and still be one chord, as a chord's notes played a little apart are. Range: 0 to 1000 |
| `` gridadvance `` | `` off `` | Whether O in the piano roll moves the cursor on by the grid step (on) or by the note's length (off) |
| `` audition `` | `` on `` | Whether the piano roll plays a note as the cursor lands on it, and as one is added or moved to a new pitch |
| `` nudge `` | `` 5 `` | How far, in milliseconds, a nudge moves a note in the piano roll, or lengthens or shortens it. Range: 1 to 1000 |
| `` humanizetime `` | `` 10 `` | How far, in milliseconds, ~ moves a note in time at most, either way. Range: 0 to 1000 |
| `` humanizevel `` | `` 8 `` | How far ~ changes a note's velocity at most, either way. Range: 0 to 127 |
| `` velclip `` | `` soft `` | How velocity changes keep within their limits: soft, easing off near them, or hard, clipping |
| `` quantizepedal `` | `` follow `` | What q does with the pedalling of the notes it quantises: follow, moving it with them; keep, leaving it where it is; or ask |
| `` velfloor `` | `` 1 `` | The lowest velocity a change makes a note. Range: 1 to 127 |
| `` pedallift `` | `` 10 `` | How long, in milliseconds, the pedalling tools lift the sustain pedal before a change. Range: 0 to 1000 |
| `` pedaldown `` | `` 60 `` | How long, in milliseconds, the pedalling tools press the sustain pedal again after a change. Range: 0 to 1000 |
| `` undolevels `` | `` 1000 `` | How many changes can be undone. Range: 0 to 100000 |
| `` ownports `` | `` 1 `` | How many MIDI output ports of its own Modal makes, for other programs to connect to (where the system lets it: Linux, not Windows). Range: 0 to 16 |
| `` ownportname `` | `` Modal `` | The name of Modal's own ports; several are numbered after it |
| `` thru `` | `` on `` | Send MIDI input through to armed tracks with Thru enabled |
| `` quantizemarks `` | `` on `` | Whether the piano roll marks where a note of a track quantised as it plays will be heard, when that's far from where it's stored |
| `` sustaintails `` | `` on `` | Whether the piano roll draws a tail after each note the sustain pedal holds past its end, to where the pedal lifts |
| `` sustaintint `` | `` off `` | Whether the piano roll tints its notes faintly wherever the sustain pedal is down |
| `` ownmeter `` | `` on `` | Whether the arrangement tints a track's bars where it has a meter of its own, rather than following the song's |
| `` rewind `` | `` on `` | Whether the play-from marker, which Space plays from, stays put when playback stops (on), or moves to where it stopped (off) |
